questions.question: Discuss survey and interview methods used in tourism research.
questions.solution_html:
• The survey method collects data from a large number of respondents using
  • questionnaires, useful for identifying trends and patterns. The interview method
  • involves direct interaction, providing in-depth information about tourist behaviour and
  • experiences. Both methods help understand the social, cultural, and economic impacts
  • of tourism and support effective planning and policy-making.
questions.final_answer: of tourism and support effective planning and policy-making

questions.question: Critically evaluate the role of ISTO in promoting social tourism at the global / level.
questions.solution_html:
• Critically evaluate the role of ISTO in promoting social tourism at the global
  • level.
  • ISTO (International Social Tourism Organisation) promotes social tourism by
  • ensuring tourism accessibility for all, including marginalized groups. It supports
  • sustainable tourism practices, encourages international cooperation, and helps
  • improve quality of life through tourism. It also advocates policies for inclusive and
  • responsible tourism development
questions.final_answer: responsible tourism development
